shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50; head -c 600 package-lock.json
for f in index.html src/* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit react sass 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -A8 '"peerDependencies"' package.json; ls; ls build/esm/components | grep -iE "^(TextInput|PasswordInput|Checkbox|Button|Card|Text|ThemeProvider|Flex|Alert)$"; ls styles | head -20; git -C /home/sandbox/workspace diff --stat
ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n -iE "styles|setup|ThemeProvider" README.md | head -20; grep -A15 '"exports"' package.json | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls controls controls/TextInput controls/PasswordInput 2>&1 | head -40; ls Checkbox

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && ls docs | head -30; grep -n "Provider" docs/INDEX.md | head; sed -n 1,80p docs/theming.md 2>/dev/null || sed -n 1,80p ../docs/theming.md

cat controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState\|errorPlacement\|label\|hasClear" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head -30; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls guides components | head -100; cat components/Provider* 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -rl "Provider" guides | head
sed -n 1,70p guides/theming.md; ls components/controls; grep -n "Flex\|Card\b" guides/layout.md | head -15
sed -n 1,60p components/controls/PasswordInput.md; sed -n 1,50p components/Card.md; grep -n "spacing-\|Spacing" guides/layout.md | sed -n 1,12p
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -rf dist; tail -8 src/index.css; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>&1 | head -3; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"
